class.name: SteamVoiceCapture
class.brief_description: Exclusive Steam microphone capture for one client scope.

method.name: start
method.description: Requests capture for this scope. Call after the player opts in and explicitly starts push-to-talk. Another owner or native tail cleanup returns [constant ERR_BUSY]. Repeating an active start from the same owner is harmless.

method.name: stop
method.description: Requests native stop. The exact owner may read final frames for up to 300 milliseconds. Scope teardown discards those frames immediately. A detached or inactive owner returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: read_frame
method.description: Polls one opaque compressed frame of up to 8192 bytes. Call once per process frame during capture. An empty poll, exhausted tail, or detached owner returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].
